title: Manage a dated personal reminder, if supported
summary: Use dated map notes and review the difference between a note date and a provider session.

evidence: server/src/utils/guideOracleKnowledge.js: reviewed original fact objects at b8345be4d2f7a097e81cb03eef64b473abd0cec9

sections.title: Add a dated private map note to Care Calendar
paragraphs: Sign in and use a My Map you own. This workflow dates a saved note attached to a map resource; it is not a general appointment form or a provider booking.
steps: Open My Directory → My Maps and open your map.
Open Map Notes and select the resource you want the note to describe.
Enter the note and wait for its save to finish. Keep Share this note off if the note should remain private.
Select Add to calendar beneath the saved, non-empty note.
In Add this private note to your calendar, enter Calendar title and Starts. Enter Ends (optional) if you need an end time. Use Singapore time.
Select Add to calendar. Care Calendar opens the day containing the new entry; check its title, date and time there.
notes: Add to calendar appears only after the note has been saved and contains text. If saving fails, resolve the note error and use Save notes before continuing.
Cancel closes the calendar form without adding an entry. The saved map note remains available.
Only you can see the dated calendar item. Sharing the original note is a separate map setting; do not put private or medical details in a shared note.
If adding the calendar entry reports an error, check that day before retrying so you do not intentionally create a second reminder for the same note.

sections.title: Move or remove a dated private map note
paragraphs: Use the calendar entry for your own saved map note. The current calendar cards offer removal; to choose another date through the app, remove that entry and add the saved note again.
steps: Open Care Calendar, select Calendar, and open the day containing the dated note.
Check the note’s title and time, then select Remove private map note on that entry. This removes the calendar item immediately.
To give the note another date, reopen its original resource in your map’s Map Notes and select Add to calendar on the saved note.
Enter the new Calendar title, Starts and any Ends (optional), then select Add to calendar. Check the new entry on its calendar day.
notes: Removing this calendar item does not delete the original map note. Stop after removal if you do not want another reminder.
If you see Remove from My Plans instead, the entry is a provider session. Use a current session offered by that provider rather than inventing a different session time.
If removal fails, check whether the old entry is still present before adding another one. A dated private note does not register you with a provider.

sections.title: Remove a Programme/service session from My Plans
paragraphs: Sign in to the account that added the session. This removes your personal plan only.
steps: Open Care Calendar and select My Plans.
Find the planned Programme/service session and check its name, date and time.
Select Remove from My Plans on that session. The action removes that personal plan immediately.
Check My Plans to confirm the entry has gone. If you registered with the provider, contact them separately about cancelling or changing that booking.
notes: This does not delete or change the provider’s Programme/service listing or schedule.
If you want a different provider session, add a current active session when one is available. If the removal reports an error, check the list before retrying.

sections.title: Add a personal date to Care Calendar

facts.title: Add a personal date to Care Calendar
facts.message: Care Calendar shows planned sessions from saved Programmes/services and dated notes from your own My Maps. To add a personal date linked to a map resource, open that resource’s Map Notes, save a note, choose Add to Calendar, then enter its title and date. I cannot verify a general appointment-entry button outside those supported sources. A calendar entry is personal planning, not a provider booking.

sections.title: Change the date of a personal plan

facts.title: Change the date of a personal plan
keywords: change the date of a personal plan
facts.message: If your plan is a provider Programme/service session, its time follows that provider’s schedule. Remove the old session from My Plans and add a different current active session if one is offered; changing your plan does not change the provider’s schedule or registration. If you mean a dated My Map note, remove its calendar entry and use Add to Calendar on the saved note to choose another date.

delete a session from my plans
facts.message: Open Care Calendar → My Plans and choose Remove from My Plans on the planned session. This removes your own calendar plan; it does not delete the provider’s Programme/service listing or cancel a provider booking. Check with the provider separately if you registered with them.
